options.description: The border's character set. Defaults to `round`, or `ascii` where `unicodeSupported()` says the terminal cannot be trusted with box drawing.
options.name: border

options.description: The environment to read the terminal from. Defaults to `process.env`.
options.name: env

options.description: How far the whole block is indented. Defaults to 0.
options.name: indent

options.description: The platform to detect for. Defaults to `process.platform`.
options.name: platform

options.description: A heading set into the top border.
options.name: title

options.description: Where the title sits. Defaults to `left`.
options.name: titleAlign

options.description: Which role colours the border, the title and the message. Defaults to `note`, which is no role at all -- the terminal's own foreground.
options.name: variant

options.description: The widest the block may be, and never under 5. Defaults to `terminalWidth()`.
options.name: width
